# Build a website with Quarto and GitHub Pages

## Overview

This short workshop shows you how to build and publish your own website
using [Quarto](https://quarto.org/), a scientific and technical
publishing system, and [GitHub Pages](https://pages.github.com/), a free
way to host a website straight from a GitHub repository.

You do not need any coding experience and you do not need to install
anything. Everything happens in your web browser. You will write plain
text, save it to GitHub, and a few moments later your website will be
live at an address you can share.

By the end of this workshop, participants will have a working website
with a home page, an about page, a navigation bar (navbar) and a look of
their own. Along the way you will learn the building blocks that you can
use to grow the site into a project page, a portfolio, a blog or a
course website like this one.

## Audience

This workshop is intended for researchers, research support staff and
others who would like a simple website for a project, a group or
themselves, and who would like to be able to update it easily. No
experience of GitHub, Quarto, HTML or programming is assumed.

## Learning objectives

Participants will learn how to:

-   Set up a GitHub account using a Google account, a Microsoft email
    address or any other email address.
-   Create and configure a GitHub repository so that it publishes a website
    to GitHub Pages.
-   Use Quarto to create website content from plain text files (`.qmd`),
    including headings, lists, links, images and callouts.
-   Create a navbar so visitors can move between the pages of your site.
-   Use a `styles.css` file to change the look of your website, including
    colours and fonts.

## Schedule

The workshop takes about two and a half hours. It can be shortened to two
hours by skipping the optional parts, or stretched to three by spending more
time on the challenges.

| Time (minutes) | What we will do |
|:---------------|:----------------|
| 0 - 15 | Welcome, what Quarto and GitHub Pages are, and a look at a finished site |
| 15 - 35 | Part 1: Set up a GitHub account |
| 35 - 60 | Part 2: Create a repository and publish it with GitHub Pages |
| 60 - 90 | Part 3: Create website content with Quarto |
| 90 - 100 | Break |
| 100 - 120 | Part 4: Create a navbar |
| 120 - 145 | Part 5: Change the look of your site with `styles.css` |
| 145 - 150 | Wrap-up and where to go next |
